parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Part two. You will hear a real estate agent giving information to a couple who want to buy a house. First, you will have some time to look at questions eleven to thirteen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to thirteen.

Hello, Mr. and Mrs. Clark. I believe you are doing well. I am Tom, the sales manager of Housed Inc, and I got your mail requesting for a house that would suit your specifications. I have been able to do some work and have come up with two options that I think should fit what you are looking for. The first house is situated on Allen Street, and the owner told me that he bought the house largely because of where it is located. The house was decorated a few years ago, but I think it still looks new to a large extent. Anyways, you might dislike the old-fashioned design of the house, which was modeled to the original owner's taste. Of course, you can arrange decorations of your own. I just have to inform you beforehand. I looked through your profile, and it said that you have a large family of six. I felt this house could be more appropriate for you with children than just young couples, as it has eight rooms, including four bedrooms. According to your budget, although the house is a bit pricey, the price hasn't exceeded your limit yet. It's very reasonable, though, for a house on Allen Street. The owner had initially fixed every afternoon for potential buyers to visit. Then he shifted it to all weekends. But by yesterday, he informed me that he would be allowing only Wednesdays during lunchtime for visits. So it means we have to go either tomorrow or next week.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions fourteen to twenty.

Now listen and answer questions fourteen to twenty.

Okay, on to the next house. I was able to get the layout of this building to help you understand it better. The house is situated on Pearl Street, just around the corner. It is a well-planned and designed house. In the southeast of the house, you can see the master room, whereas the dining room is in the northwestern corner. There is a bathroom in the southwestern corner of the house that is modern and well-equipped. It provides adequate storage for the whole family.

As for the bedroom, which is kept especially for visitors, it is in the direct south of the house, just between the bathroom and the master room. You will see the kitchen to your left when you just step in the house. Of course, I should give as much information as I can so as to help you in the decision-making process. The second house has both advantages and disadvantages, and you should know well about them. First, the premises are quite lovely, and there is a small garden just behind the main building. Also, you do not have to manage space with other neighbors since there is a big parking lot, unlike the first house. As you can see, north of the house, you have a lot of banks, and to the east and west, there are a good number of companies and malls. It is very compact and easily accessible due to its central location. Again, in contrast to the first house, there are only two bedrooms, and this would have been good for a young couple with a small family size. However, for a family size like yours, I really am not sure. But if necessary, perhaps you could turn the storeroom into a bedroom. Then there will be three bedrooms. The last problem is that it lacks a garage, which is a very important feature for residents here, as every household has at least one car, and there are few public car parks in this area. This is all I have for now, and...

That is the end of part two. You now have forty-five seconds to check your answers to part two.

questions.question: Why does the speaker recommend the first house?

analyses.content: 录音中明确指出房主买下这栋房子主要是因为它的地理位置很好。
你可能会因为没听懂“where it is located”指代的就是选项中的“location”而不敢选择。
The first house is situated on Allen Street, and the owner told me that he bought the house largely because of where it is located.

questions.question: Why does the speaker recommend the first house?

analyses.content: 录音中提到房子房间很多，对于有孩子的大家庭来说非常合适。
录音里出现了“old-fashioned design”和“a bit pricey”，可以直接排除干扰项B和C，你可能会因为只抓听到只言片语而没有跟上整个句意导致误选。

I looked through your profile, and it said that you have a large family of six. I felt this house could be more appropriate for you with children than just young couples, as it has eight rooms, including four bedrooms.

questions.question: When could potential buyers visit the first house?

analyses.content: 录音最后确认了房主现在只允许在周三午餐时间进行参观。
你可能会因为听到“every afternoon”或“all weekends”就匆忙选择，没有跟上后面由“But”引出的最终真实答案。

The owner had initially fixed every afternoon for potential buyers to visit. Then he shifted it to all weekends. But by yesterday, he informed me that he would be allowing only Wednesdays during lunchtime for visits.
录音明确说明主卧（master room）位于房子的东南角（southeast），对应地图的右下角C位置。
你可能会因为分不清东南（southeast）的具体方位而找错了参照位置。
In the southeast of the house, you can see the master room, whereas the dining room is in the northwestern corner.
录音指出浴室（bathroom）在房子的西南角（southwestern），也就是地图的左下角A位置。
地图题节奏较快，你可能会跟丢了方位词“southwestern”，导致在底部的A、C、D中犹豫不决。
There is a bathroom in the southwestern corner of the house that is modern and well-equipped. It provides adequate storage for the whole family.
录音提到留给访客的卧室在房子的正南方（direct south），刚好在浴室和主卧之间，对应D位置。
你可能会因为录音用的是“bedroom for visitors”而不是题干的“guest room”而没有反应过来，从而丢失了行进路线。
As for the bedroom, which is kept especially for visitors, it is in the direct south of the house, just between the bathroom and the master room.

analyses.content: 录音提到不需要和邻居抢空间，因为这里有一个很大的停车场（parking lot）。
你可能会因为听到“big”只抓住了大方向，但忽略了整体语义，没能填对完整的“parking lot”。
Also, you do not have to manage space with other neighbors since there is a big parking lot, unlike the first house.
录音总结说因为这栋房子处于中心位置（central location），所以非常紧凑且交通便利。
你可能会被前面的一大堆干扰信息（如banks, companies, malls）吸引注意力，从而错过了“due to”后面的核心答案。

As you can see, north of the house, you have a lot of banks, and to the east and west, there are a good number of companies and malls. It is very compact and easily accessible due to its central location.
录音明确指出，和第一栋房子相比，这里只有两个卧室（two bedrooms）。
你可能会因为忽略了题干中“only has”的限制，而在后续听到的干扰信息“three bedrooms”中产生动摇。
Again, in contrast to the first house, there are only two bedrooms, and this would have been good for a young couple with a small family size.
录音提到最后一个问题是这栋房子缺少一个车库（garage）。
你可能会因为没反应过来“lacks”（缺少）就是题干中“no”的同义替换，或者被后面解释原因时出现的“car parks”干扰而填错词。
The last problem is that it lacks a garage, which is a very important feature for residents here, as every household has at least one car, and there are few public car parks in this area.
